Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1613797. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and to compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1613797, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
